page.title: My cards
page.emptyHint: Create a card to hand it over with a link or QR code. You can make several cards with different titles and roles.

closed.no_name: Add a name to open the link
closed.email_unverified: Verify your email to open the link
closed.owner_inactive: The link is closed because of your account status

create.title: Add card
create.label: Card name
create.labelHint: Only you see this name. Recipients don't.
create.sourceHint: Fills in your profile in the chosen workspace (name, title), the company info (name, address, main phone, website) and your account email and mobile. You can edit everything afterwards.

editor.publicNotice: Anyone with the link or QR code can see this card. Only add information you're happy to share.
editor.label: Card name
editor.name: Name
editor.introPlaceholder: e.g. I plan brand strategy and web services.
editor.photoHint: Shown on the card if added; without one the card has no photo area. JPG, PNG, WebP · up to 8MB. Location data is removed.
editor.photoTooLarge: The photo is too large (8MB max).
editor.photoUnreadable: We can't read this image. Please use JPG, PNG or WebP.
editor.publicHint: Turning it off closes the link and QR right away. Copies already saved by others remain.
editor.refillHint: Refill fields from workspace and account info.
editor.refillAllConfirm: Your current name, title and contacts will be replaced with the loaded values. Fields with no loaded value stay as they are.

errors.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with https://.

qr.title: Card link & QR
qr.hint: Scanning with a phone camera opens the card page. This QR code is for this card only.
qr.closedWarn: The link is closed right now, so scanning won't show the card.

confirm.delete: This card's link and QR code will stop working. Copies already saved by others remain.
confirm.rotate: The current link and any printed QR code will stop working. Copies already saved by others remain — turn the link off to withdraw your info.
confirm.off: Nobody will be able to view the card with the link or QR. Turning it back on reopens the same link.

saved.emptyHint: Open a card link you received and tap “Save to my cards” to collect it here.
saved.memoPlaceholder: Where you got it, things to remember
saved.deleteMsg: It's removed from your saved cards only. The owner isn't affected.
saved.closedHint: The owner turned off or deleted the link. Your saved copy stays as it is.

public.loginToSave: Log in to save this card
public.notFoundHint: The link may have changed, or the owner turned it off.
